req.title: Task update rejects id changes
req.statement: The system shall ignore any id field in the PUT body and only mutate the task addressed by the URL.

doc.reasoning: R-TASK-038 requires that when a client sends a PUT /tasks/{id} request with an 'id' field in the body, the system ignores that field and mutates only the task addressed by the URL path parameter. The TaskUpdate schema does not include an 'id' field, so FastAPI/Pydantic will strip it before it reaches crud.update_task. Tests must verify: (1) positive — a PUT with a body containing a different id still returns 2xx and the response id matches the URL id, not the body id; (2) negative — a PUT to a non-existent task id returns 404; (3) boundary — a PUT where the body id equals an existing but different task's id still updates only the URL-addressed task and leaves the other task untouched. Additional tests cover exact field values and mutation-resilient assertions on status codes and response body fields.

tests.name: test_put_ignores_body_id_returns_url_task
preconditions: Task with id=1 exists (title='Read chapter 5', completed=true)
Task with id=2 exists (title='Book flight tickets', completed=true)
actions: Send PUT /tasks/1 with JSON body {"title": "Updated Title", "id": 2}
Inspect response status code and body
expected: Response body id == 1 (URL id, not body id 2)
trace: R-TASK-038: system shall ignore id field in PUT body
R-TASK-038: only mutate task addressed by URL
tests.executable:
import os, sys
os.environ.setdefault('DATABASE_URL', 'sqlite://')
from sqlalchemy import create_engine
from sqlalchemy.orm import sessionmaker
from app.database import Base, get_db
from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

engine = create_engine('sqlite://', connect_args={'check_same_thread': False})
TestingSessionLocal = sessionmaker(bind=engine)
Base.metadata.create_all(bind=engine)

def override_get_db():
    db = TestingSessionLocal()
    try:
        yield db
    finally:
        db.close()

app.dependency_overrides[get_db] = override_get_db
client = TestClient(app)

client.post('/tasks/', json={'title': 'Read chapter 5', 'completed': True})
client.post('/tasks/', json={'title': 'Book flight tickets', 'completed': True})

def test_put_ignores_body_id_returns_url_task():
    r = client.put('/tasks/1', json={'title': 'Updated Title', 'id': 2})
    assert r.status_code == 200
    body = r.json()
    assert body['id'] == 1
    assert body['title'] == 'Updated Title'
    assert body['completed'] == True

test_put_ignores_body_id_returns_url_task()

actions: Send GET /tasks/2 to verify task 2 is unchanged
expected: GET /tasks/2 returns HTTP 200 with title=='Book flight tickets' (unchanged)

import os
from sqlalchemy import create_engine
from sqlalchemy.orm import sessionmaker
from app.database import Base, get_db
from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

engine2 = create_engine('sqlite://', connect_args={'check_same_thread': False})
Session2 = sessionmaker(bind=engine2)
Base.metadata.create_all(bind=engine2)

def override2():
    db = Session2()
    try:
        yield db
    finally:
        db.close()

app.dependency_overrides[get_db] = override2
client2 = TestClient(app)

client2.post('/tasks/', json={'title': 'Task One', 'completed': False})
client2.post('/tasks/', json={'title': 'Book flight tickets', 'completed': True})

def test_put_body_id_does_not_mutate_other_task():
    r_put = client2.put('/tasks/1', json={'title': 'Changed', 'id': 2})
    assert r_put.status_code == 200
    assert r_put.json()['id'] == 1
    assert r_put.json()['title'] == 'Changed'
    r_get = client2.get('/tasks/2')
    assert r_get.status_code == 200
    assert r_get.json()['id'] == 2
    assert r_get.json()['title'] == 'Book flight tickets'

test_put_body_id_does_not_mutate_other_task()
